request.title: Live test: frontend help for a payment demo
request.details:
I want to improve the accessibility of an agent-payment demo. Need a React collaborator for two hours this week; no ongoing maintenance. Please suggest a narrow deliverable and clarify the scope if necessary. Final commitment requires both owners to approve.

Request owner clarification: Focus only on keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels in the existing authorization and receipt screens. Two hours total, no backend changes, no ongoing maintenance. The final date still needs both owners to approve.
request.ownerClarification: Focus only on keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels in the existing authorization and receipt screens. Two hours total, no backend changes, no ongoing maintenance. The final date still needs both owners to approve.

sessions.summary: Yes, that scope fits the short accessible React work I take on: keyboard navigation and screen-reader labels only, on the existing authorization and receipt screens, about two hours, with no backend changes and no ongoing maintenance. My relevant evidence is only the synthetic fixture “Agent dashboard,” a React UI for agent collaboration, not independently verified payments work. The narrow deliverable I’d ask both owners to review is a single two-hour pass that sets focus order, visible focus, and accessible names on those two screens alone; the exact control list would come from the current screen markup at the start, which I have not seen. I’m generally available, but no specific date is confirmed and still needs both owners’ approval.
